lines.2: 「So, this is just a little welcome party! We've only got prepared food from the shops, but we picked the good stuff.」
lines.3: 「Here's to getting along from now on.」
lines.10: 「You thought we were a bunch of irresponsible losers, didn't you? How rude, talking that way to a lady.」
lines.11: 「A lady doesn't talk with her mouth full.」
lines.12: 「Allow me to pour you a drink. It's only oolong tea, though.」
lines.14: 「It's an honor to pour for a beautiful woman.」
lines.15: 「I was certain you would get carried away and buy alcohol.」
lines.17: 「That helps. I would rather not be a scold at a gathering like this.」
lines.18: 「Not at all! Your lectures really speak to the heart, Otome.」
lines.21: 「He can only survive by clinging to the strong. He's less a shark than a remora.」
lines.22: 「Personally, I'm thrilled to have a beautiful woman move in close by.」
lines.23: 「There haven't been any women around here.」
lines.24: 「What's that supposed to mean? I'm right in front of you!」
lines.27: 「A little kid might be one thing, but I don't see a creature your age with a bust under eighty centimeters as a woman.」
lines.28: 「Y-you attacked my body... when you're ugly yourself!」
lines.29: 「Ug--ugly?! What do you think a man's face is worth?!」
